label: Good idea: GST filing help
idea: Fixed-price GST and income-tax filing help for freelancers and small online sellers in India, delivered by a partner chartered accountant through a simple web portal. Customers pay a flat yearly plan online and upload documents securely. The founder handles onboarding and support while the accountant partner signs off each filing.

label: Weak idea: general marketplace
idea: A general online marketplace where anyone can buy and sell anything, from electronics to groceries to services. It will compete head-on with Amazon and Flipkart by charging a lower commission and offering the same delivery speed. The founder plans to fund the platform and the logistics network from savings.

label: Borderline: homemade food
idea: Homemade tiffin meals and baked snacks sold through weekly pre-orders in one Indian city. The founder cooks from a home kitchen, takes orders on a simple website and delivers through a local courier. Customers choose from a small rotating menu and pay online in advance.
